releases.title: Wand, hands and beams
notes: Granular is an effect on everything you play (the GRN tile on the FX screen), with tempo-synced rhythm and a fifth or octave layer.
The granular page is a wizard's wand; Reverb is a pair of hands casting a spell; Phaser is a hand shooting energy beams.
Nine new sounds, no keyboard strip, and the startup line reads an Obby Mall synth.
